facts.fact: ARTCI's press release lists a 2013 data protection law at the start of Cote d'Ivoire's record, followed by compliance checks in 2022 and simplified norms in 2025.
facts.system: Loi 2013 relative a la protection des donnees personnelles

facts.fact: ARTCI's press release says its new regulatory Council, named on 21 April 2026 and sworn in on 7 May 2026, under president Roger Felix Adom, covers personal data protection among its fields.
facts.system: Autorite de Regulation des Telecommunications/TIC de Cote d'Ivoire (ARTCI)

facts.fact: ARTCI's press release lists awareness campaigns from 2015, compliance checks in 2022, a national forum in 2023 and a national file of correspondents in 2026 among Cote d'Ivoire's data protection milestones.
facts.system: Autorite de Regulation des Telecommunications/TIC de Cote d'Ivoire (ARTCI)
